evidence_items.explanation: The late-2025 convenience survey provides evidence consistent with low switching barriers, but also finds task specialization and advantages associated with ChatGPT’s established users. Its limitations explicitly say the cross-sectional design cannot establish causal relationships.

The US consumer survey finds distinct platform roles, qualifying a broad claim of product sameness. It is context only because June fieldwork is not shown to precede June 16, and it does not explain the historical change in global audience share.
